claims.claim_text: The Board provides oversight of climate-related risks and opportunities.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Governance oversight of climate-related risks and opportunities (sentence 1)
claims.support_notes: Explicit statement of Board oversight; does not describe terms of reference/mandates.

evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Governance oversight... ("Board comprises 10 directors")
claims.support_notes: Quantitative composition disclosed; not directly mapped to listed IFRS governance clauses.

claims.claim_text: The Board holds 4 full Board meetings per year.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Governance oversight... ("holds 4 full Board meetings per year")
claims.support_notes: Meeting frequency disclosed; not necessarily the frequency of climate-related reporting/informing.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related matters are included on the Board agenda 69.8% of the time.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Governance oversight... ("included on the Board agenda 69.8% of the time")
claims.support_notes: Supports how often the Board is informed/engages, but does not specify reporting mechanism.

claims.claim_text: Board minutes reflect discussions including transition plan review, scenario analysis, TCFD review, net zero progress, carbon credit approval and executive remuneration ESG KPIs.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Governance oversight... (bullet list under "Board discussions captured in Board minutes include")
claims.support_notes: Indicates Board consideration of strategy/targets/remuneration topics; does not evidence trade-offs or target-setting process details.

claims.claim_text: Climate risk reporting is provided to the Board on a semi-annual basis.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Governance oversight... ("Climate risk reporting... semi-annual")
claims.support_notes: Directly addresses how often the Board is informed.

claims.claim_text: An ESG committee is in place and met 5, 6 and 7 times per year across the reported governance records.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Governance oversight... ("An ESG committee is in place and met 5, 6 and 7 times per year")
claims.support_notes: Identifies a governance body; does not describe its mandate/terms of reference.

claims.claim_text: The Board’s oversight of climate-related performance is linked to remuneration through climate-related components of executive remuneration.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Governance oversight... ("linked to remuneration")
claims.support_notes: States linkage; does not describe governance process for setting/monitoring targets.

claims.claim_text: The proportion of executive remuneration linked to climate-related factors is 8.7%, 15.3% and 15.1% across the reported governance records.
claims.support_notes: Quantifies remuneration linkage; underlying basis/periods not specified.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related considerations are incorporated into decisions on major transactions through a climate check for major transactions.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Governance oversight... ("climate check for major transactions")
claims.support_notes: Addresses consideration in major transactions; no detail on methodology or trade-offs.

claims.claim_text: Management oversight is delegated to a management-level committee.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Management’s role, controls and procedures ("delegated to a management-level committee")
claims.support_notes: Meets delegation disclosure at a high level; does not explain how oversight is exercised.

claims.claim_text: The management committee identified for climate oversight is recorded as Group Sustainability Committee, ESG Executive Committee and Climate Risk Management Committee.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Management’s role... (list of committees)
claims.support_notes: Identifies committees; ambiguity remains whether these are alternatives across records or concurrent bodies.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related risk management is integrated into enterprise risk management (ERM integration: True).
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Management’s role... ("ERM integration: True")
claims.support_notes: Indicates integration with internal functions/processes; lacks description of specific controls/procedures.

claims.claim_text: Board climate expertise is tracked, with 33.5%, 35.5% and 37.5% of the Board identified as having climate expertise across the reported governance records.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Skills and competencies ("33.5%, 35.5% and 37.5%")
claims.support_notes: Supports disclosure about skills/competencies availability; does not explain assessment method.

claims.claim_text: A skills development programme is in place (True).
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Governance > Skills and competencies ("skills development programme... True")
claims.support_notes: Indicates development mechanism exists; no detail on scope, governance, or timelines.
